description: STAUFF type MLC 2-, 3-, 4-, or 6-line pipe-clamp body: separate upper/lower molded halves with outside ribbed reliefs and fastener bosses, fixed HV smooth seats, tension clearance, and fastener passages. Catalogue material codes PP, PA, and PA-VO do not change geometry.
source: STAUFF Catalogue 1 - STAUFF Clamps, 06/2026, pages 114-117; supplied 6100246250 STEP for the 2-line Group-1 envelope and molded outside topology; documented proportion rules for unmarked local dimensions
